source.title: Shredder Turbochargers
source.objective:
ProgressIt's bad luck that shipping lanes back to Kezan are so unreliable these days. Back home you can get Turbochargers by the dozen for a few copper. Fallin' off the shelves at every machine shop. Can't get rid of 'em fast enough.

Anyway, if you've got a few Turbochargers you don't know what to do with, I'd be happy to take them off your hands!
source.completion: Thanks a lot, <name>. I'll put this to good use.
